name: Divine Smite
summary: Adds 2d8 Radiant damage to a melee hit, more against Fiends and Undead.

castingTime.trigger: immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an {ref:glossary/unarmed-strike}

stats.effect: The target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from the attack. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.
